source.description: arq_uuid accepted from caller (KB entry-point) and interpolated into Cyborg API URL path in get_arq_by_uuid

sink.description: HTTP GET /accelerator_requests/{arq_uuid}: arq_uuid concatenated into URL path via "/".join([self.ARQ_URL, arq_uuid]) without UUID-format or path-character validation

stoppedAt.detail: get_arq_by_uuid (defined at cyborg.py:337) has no production call site in the 1484-file source set. virt/libvirt/driver.py (now extracted) uses accel_info ARQ dicts passed in from the compute manager but does not call get_arq_by_uuid. grep confirms no production call anywhere. Test fixture (CyborgFixture at tests/fixtures/cyborg.py:274-277) still provides the only evidence that the method is called in production — via MockPatch consumed by compute manager and libvirt driver tests. The production call site has not been found in any extracted file across all 1484 files.

sanitisationGaps: No UUID format check or path-character filtering visible between method parameter (line 337) and HTTP call (lines 358-359) in get_arq_by_uuid.
